name: costas_array_n15__v1_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 15: place 15 marks on an 15x15 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 15*(14)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 15 integers in 0..14, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
